name: Venom Carrier
effect:
After an unarmed tail attack that deals damage, reflexively inject venom (resisted with Brute like a normal poison/venom). Marque by level: I (1–3), II (4–7), III (8–11), IV (12). One dose; it refills at the end of your next turn after use.
Mq I: 4 unsoakable damage, −1 Accuracy and Evade for 1 turn.
Mq II: 8 unsoakable, −1 Acc/Eva for 2 turns.
Mq III: 12 unsoakable, −2 Acc/Eva for 2 turns.
Mq IV: 16 unsoakable, −2 Acc/Eva for 3 turns.
Note: the venom can be harvested like a normal animal venom (rules in Pets and Predators).

name: Airborne Threat
effect: Bat wings: fly speed 20 ft, reduced by armor swim/climb penalties. Unless bound, unconscious or in inclement weather, you take no falling damage. Two new called-shot locations (wings, resisted with Dexterity). Normal: that wing is unusable for 1 turn (you fall if flying; 2 AP reflexive to land safely). Wound: sprained wing, unusable until your next breather, and no safe falling. Fatal: the wing is permanently removed and you bleed out (death in 3 turns unless you spend at least 3 AP bandaging).

name: Massive Stature
effect: Just over 9 ft tall: melee reach +5 ft, +1 DC on unarmed, melee and thrown attacks.

name: Self-Replenishing
effect: Regain wounds per day equal to your max AP by level (instead of 1). Recover from wound effects at twice the normal rate. You can fully regrow one lost called-shot location over a few weeks.
